metadata.literal_pointer: PDF page 13: 'The Group had 0.5 GW of data centre projects in WIP at 30 June 2026' and the WIP cohort described as data centre projects under construction. PDF page 14 table: HKG10, Hong Kong SAR, GHKDCP, Fully Fitted, 50 MW WIP, 'Conversion of existing industrial building located in Tsuen Wan'. PDF page 15: 'Project delivery program for development projects in WIP at 30 June 2026' lists HKG10 with an RFS bar spanning 2027-2028.
metadata.visual_review_method: Complete Poppler-rendered pages at 110 dpi reviewed; extracted layout text used only as a cross-check because the page-14 table's text extraction interleaves rows. Page 16 (TYO05) was reviewed only to confirm it concerns a different project; its construction photograph is not imagery evidence.
metadata.independent_recapture: The round43 capture from the original URL is byte-identical (same SHA-256 and length) to tmp/research-round42-east-asia-official/r42-eao-goodman-fy26-results-presentation.pdf and to the content hash of the six Goodman FY26 evidence rows already in the thirty-fifth reviewed draft (AMS01, FRA02, LAX01, MAD01, PAR01, PAR02).
metadata.date_semantics: 30 June 2026 is the explicit as-of date of the WIP cohort and of the project delivery program that names HKG10. The PDF's document information records creation at 2026-08-19T22:50:14Z (20 August AEST), and the identical document is dated 2026-08-19 in the six admitted Goodman FY26 evidence rows. As with those admissions and the NEXTDC FY26 and Range half-year precedents, the in-window as-of date is selected; publication and the October retrieval create no later observation.
metadata.authority_basis: Listed issuer's annual results presentation lodged as an ASX announcement, describing its own named development project. Selected under the same rule already applied to the six Goodman FY26 admissions.
metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction only: HKG10 was in Goodman's data-centre development WIP cohort at 30 June 2026. No construction stage, powered-shell completion, MEP progress, capacity, tenant or energization is normalized.
metadata.corroboration_not_selected: Goodman's Q3 FY26 operational update (as at 31 March 2026) describes HKG10 as the redevelopment of an existing industrial building with the powered shell on schedule for completion late 2026 (tmp/research-round42-east-asia-official/r42-eao-goodman-q3-fy26-update.pdf, sha256 713196902d9c92df2502874d5cfa44f86a2ac4de35022a76f33983dba8053227). Goodman's own HKG10 listing, posted 2026-08-17, labels the project 'Under construction' (evidence ap43-hkg10-goodman-listing-128-texaco-road). Neither is selected.
metadata.forecast_not_selected: The page-15 RFS bar (2027-2028), the listing tag 'Full completion in 2026' and the September 2026 statements about first capacity in early 2028 are forecasts and create no lifecycle observation.
metadata.successor_review: Goodman's HKG10 listing (posted 2026-08-17, archived 2026-08-26) still labels the project under construction; the FY26 program places RFS in 2027-2028; secondary coverage of Goodman's 16 September 2026 equity raise says the proceeds fund HKG10's mechanical and electrical fit-out with first capacity in early 2028. No completion, opening, cancellation or stop was found on or before 2026-08-20. Bounded original-source review, not an exhaustive permit or inspection audit.
metadata.code_alias_swap_resolution: Goodman's 1Q FY26 material (and, per the round2 packet's identity_warning, 1H FY26 material) labels the Tsuen Wan industrial-building redevelopment HKG09 and the Kwai Chung development HKG10. From the Q3 FY26 update (as at 31 March 2026; PDF page 6 table and page 7 panel, viewed) onward, Goodman labels Kwai Chung HKG09 and the Tsuen Wan conversion HKG10. The selected FY26 row itself states 'Conversion of existing industrial building located in Tsuen Wan', and the August 2026 listing binds HKG10 to 128 Texaco Road, so the binding is date-specific and carries the locality in the same row. No older code alias is merged, and the admitted HKG09 Kwai Chung row is unaffected.
